2026-10-12 · beowulf-fitt-09 · Cruces rendered from the lexica and flagged as guesses in the notes: (a) 599–601 ac hē lust wigeð, swefeð ond sendeþ (`l` "bears lust, puts to sleep and sends", `i` "takes his pleasure, kills and sends (them off)"; sendeþ has no object and the apparatus offers Kemble's [on] lust wīgeð, Bugge's [on] lust þigeð and seven other readings of swefeð ond sendeþ; some editors cancel ic at 601); (b) 646–651 the time clauses (oþðe kept as "or", the apparatus has "oð þæt" and an inserted [ne] at 648; scaduhelma gesceapu rendered "shadow-helmed shapes", a guess at dusk); (c) 620–621 dǣl ǣghwylcne with duguþe ond geogoþe taken as "each share of the seasoned and the young", the construction loose; (d) 581 wiht fram þē … searonīða … brōgan (wiht as adverb or noun, fram þē "about you", brōgan number); (e) 586 [fela] (Klaeber, after the apparatus’s “Gr.1” and Sedgefield) against [geflites] (Kluge, Holthausen, Schücking, Chambers); (f) 574 mid sweorde ofslōh (Rieger mēce, Holthausen ābrēat); (g) 565 brontne ford rendered "steep strait" and ȳðlāfe "wave-leaving", both guesses; also lāðgetēonan (559), swaþredon (569), fāra feng (578), hēafodmǣgum (583, "nearest kin"), werhðo (588, "damnation"), ealdre þīnum (590, "chief", the other reading being "life"), the odd genitive lēode in ēower lēode (596) and lēode Deniga (599), nȳdbāde (598, "forced-toll"), sweglwered (606, "sky-clad"), cynna gemyndig (613), the half-line order at 643, and hǣl against healle at 653. Glossary: the shared entries for wiste, wit, wan, ful, þearf, hǣl, aldre, gēoce, duguþe, geogoþe, ealle, eall, hīo, næs and lēode do not fit this part and are broadened. Decided meanwhile: published as flagged.
